comment: Exceptions to the helix-lint preset (#1367). Every entry needs `files` (globs), `rules` and a `reason`; helixAllow throws without one and so fails `pnpm lint`. Remove an entry when its files migrate. Stylelint rules and `helix/no-raw-control` are listed under their own key.

stylelint.reason: Terminal palette (--term-*, xterm.js light and dark) and the status bar tones --h-warn-color/--h-error-color: literal colors with no Helix token; only this file may use hex

eslint.reason: Run picker is a native select: hx-select has no option groups (ui/select-usage.spec.ts); remove when helix-ui adds them
Invisible full-surface backdrop button that closes the overlay on click; it has no control look, so hx-button does not fit
Menu items of app-context-menu own roving focus and keyboard handling (ADR in frontend.md); move to hx-list-row when helix-ui offers a menu item
Whole-row notification entry that carries the unread state and nested actions; a row, not a button look (hx-list-row would change the markup contract)
Visually hidden radio inputs behind selectable type cards (label.type); hx-radio has no card layout
Tab bar is a helix-ui candidate that implements its own tab, scroll and close buttons; they move to helix-ui with it
